verdict.rationale: GitCafe's first-party docs describe rulesets that protect matching branches or tags and can require pull requests, reviews and passing checks, and can block deletion and force pushes. They also offer an Evaluate (warn-only) mode and CODEOWNERS-based approval, and checks come from Buildkite and GitHub Actions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that rulesets enforce reviews and checks as documented.
